answer.rationale: Rollback is unavailable: compliance forbids reverting the security patch, so memory_b1 cannot be used. Circuit breaking (memory_b4) fails fast and would drop customer writes, which violates the objective. The live symptom is write-path p99 at 5x during peak settlement writes, which is a load/headroom problem more than a proven regional fault. memory_b5 helped write latency only when report/read load was on the primary; that contention is not evidenced here. memory_b3 is the closest match but describes provisioning before a peak, not mid-surge—verify that record before committing. Add capacity so writes keep being accepted. Cause could still be the new release rather than saturation.
